title: Compare Two Market Choices

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料；尚待独立教学与发音审核。

instructions: Prepare briefly and record your own response of 120–160 words. The sample is shorter than the 90–120 second target. Add relevant details and allow natural pauses while staying within 120–160 words.
prompt: Speak for about 90–120 seconds, using 120–160 words. Describe two fictional products at a market, compare their fit, quality and price, and explain one question you would ask before payment. Use at least six lesson words.
reference: At a fictional market, I would look for a pair of gloves. One stall might have cotton gloves, while another vendor offers wool ones. Although the wool pair feels warm and has stronger seams, the cotton pair fits my hands better. The wool gloves cost twenty dollars, while the cotton ones cost sixteen. I would check the final payment before opening my purse. If there is a sale or a coupon, I would ask whether the two can be used together. I would also ask the seller to show me the written warranty and explain where to read its terms. A famous brand does not always prove good quality, so I would check the seams as well. I want a durable product that I will use often. The best value for me is a comfortable pair, even if it is not the cheapest bargain.
